title: An early registration record
summary: A 2019 SIGS presentation records registration at UC Irvine in 2008. This is an attributed historical statement.

title: A community on campus
summary: SIGS invited students to Nowruz, a barbecue and an art exhibition, and joined international graduate orientation.

title: Persian literature and film
summary: Five dated Rumi and Shams sessions and the Saadat Abad screening invitation add literature and film to the archive.

summary: SIGS advertised Hush! Girls Don't Scream with a filmmaker Q&A, followed by a Nowruz invitation at the Student Center.

summary: The archive includes a documented Yalda gathering with the Persian Language & Culture Club.

title: Film and conversation
summary: The Tales announcement adds film and discussion to the archive, alongside Nowruz and Yalda.

title: Welcoming new students
summary: A welcome gathering was advertised at Verano Place BBQ. Docunight screenings are documented for the 2017-2018 period.

title: Connections beyond campus
summary: SIGS co-sponsored the Iranian American Innovation Forum with IACP and SUTA.

title: A place for poetry
summary: The archive preserves a Persian Poetry Night alongside the year’s Nowruz and Yalda gatherings.

summary: The Nowruz celebration was cancelled. Later that year, SIGS advertised a virtual Yalda with poetry and music.

title: An online Nowruz announcement
summary: SIGS advertised a Milad Derakhshani online concert for Nowruz.

title: Students for Students
summary: Students formed a human chain at Humanities Gateway Bridge in solidarity with students in Iran. SIGS shared the invitation and a later account.

title: Welcoming another cohort
summary: SIGS welcomed new students at Palo Verde with support from the ISC NewComers program.

title: Movie night and Crystal Cove
summary: The archive preserves invitations for a Crystal Cove hike and a movie night at Verano Place.

title: The 2026-2027 team
summary: The 2026-2027 team includes Board, Support Team and Advisor roles.
